usedFor: Form.taxi collects form answers, and HubSpot updates the matching contact when “New Submission Arrives” runs “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission Arrives” in Form.taxi, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A submitted form refreshes the contact's details in HubSpot, so the CRM reflects what the person just told you.

watchOut: “Update Contact” in HubSpot finds the contact by email, so a submission from a new address has nothing to update.
